newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela soldier injured in Colombia rebel attack.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela soldier injured in Colombia rebel attack.

text.p: A heavily-armed group presumed to be Colombian guerrillas attacked a Venezuelan army patrol early on Wednesday, seriously injuring one soldier, army officials said.

The patrol of five soldiers was surprised by a column of armed rebels at about 2 a.m. (0700 GMT) in the Paez district of Apure state, about two miles (three km) from the border, an army spokesman said.
Paratrooper Jesus Isidoro Castillo received serious injuries from bullet wounds and was taken to a hospital in this Andean city about 500 miles (800 km) southwest of Caracas.
Army sources could not confirm a report by local Union Radio that the attack was carried out by 25 to 30 rebels of Colombia's Marxist National Liberation Army (ELN).
It was the most serious attack along the Venezuela-Colombia frontier since two soldiers were killed by ELN rebels in April.
Venezuela frequently criticises Colombia for inadequate security along the 1,400 mile (2,200 km) border, where smuggling, kidnapping and armed skirmishes have increased.
